summary: Full-stack MVP validation for LensTranslate. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases passed including root, languages, Gemini OCR+translate (French->English of 'Bonjour le monde'), history persistence + sort desc + no _id, single delete, and clear all. Frontend (web preview, mobile viewport 390x844): loads without red screen, all key testIDs present, camera-fallback shows 'Camera preview isn't available on web', theme toggle switches dark<->light, target language picker navigates to /languages, search filter works, tapping Spanish stores selection to AsyncStorage and returns to home with TO=Spanish, history route shows empty state with Clear button hidden when empty.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: logger is instantiated AFTER it is used inside translate() exception handler (line 173) — currently harmless because module-level logging is configured, but move logger init above route handlers for clarity.
server.py DELETE /api/history/{item_id} always returns 200 even when nothing deleted; consider 404 when deleted_count==0 for stricter API semantics.
translate() persists history but the returned response omits original/translated summary — clients rely on blocks; acceptable but document.
index.tsx: capture path assumes camera preview maps 1:1 to screen; on devices with different aspect ratios crop may be off — consider using layout measurement of CameraView.
seed_data_creation: Tests create and clean up their own history entries via translate + delete/clear. No persistent seed data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend uses emergentintegrations Gemini 3 Flash (gemini-3-flash-preview). Real image tests take ~5-10s; keep timeout>=60s. Use PIL to render text on JPEG (see test_translate_api.py fixture). Frontend web preview shows camera fallback by design; capture-button is disabled on web (cameraReady=false).
